<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>마음번역소 | 몰입형 장편 비주얼 노벨</title>
<style>
:root{
 --navy:#243554;--ink:#1d2737;--muted:#687386;--paper:#fffdf8;--bg:#eef2f7;
 --orange:#ef9d3f;--gold:#ffd47a;--mint:#c9f1e8;--purple:#ead9ff;--sky:#c9eaff;--rose:#ffd8dc;
 --line:#dfe5ee;--good:#237a62;--goodbg:#e8f8f2;--bad:#984a4a;--badbg:#fff0f0;--shadow:0 18px 46px rgba(33,45,70,.15)
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;height:100%;font-family:"Pretendard","Noto Sans KR","Apple SD Gothic Neo",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg)}
button{font:inherit}button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffc85f;outline-offset:2px}
.screen{display:none;min-height:100vh}.screen.active{display:flex}
#home{align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:28px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ffd691,#ef9d3f 56%,#f7c275);overflow:auto}
.home-card{width:min(1180px,96vw);background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);border-radius:30px;padding:38px 42px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.brand{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:8px 13px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff0c8;border:1px solid #efc878;font-weight:900;color:#704700}
.home-title{font-size:clamp(50px,7vw,82px);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.055em;margin:18px 0 10px}.home-title span{color:#dc7923}.home-desc{font-size:18px;line-height:1.75;color:#4f5b70;max-width:900px;margin:0}
.promise{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:18px 0}.promise span{font-size:14px;font-weight:850;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:11px;background:#f5f7fb;border:1px solid #e1e6ee}
.mode-row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:20px 0}.btn{border:0;border-radius:13px;padding:12px 16px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}.primary{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(36,53,84,.2)}.soft{background:#fff0c8;color:#6c470c;border:1px solid #edc574}.ghost{background:#f1f4f8;color:#435069}.danger{background:#fff0f0;color:#8a4444;border:1px solid #efcaca}
.scenario-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}.scenario-card{border:1px solid #dde4ed;background:#fff;border-radius:17px;padding:16px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}.scenario-card:hover{border-color:#e7a34e;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(36,48,72,.1);transform:translateY(-2px)}.scenario-card small{font-weight:950;color:#dd7922}.scenario-card strong{display:block;font-size:18px;margin:5px 0}.scenario-card p{margin:0;color:#687386;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
#game{flex-direction:column;height:100vh;overflow:hidden;background:#f2f5f9}.topbar{height:68px;flex:0 0 68px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:0 18px;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(23,34,55,.18);z-index:5}.brand-mini{font-weight:950;font-size:18px}.case-mini{font-size:12px;opacity:.72;margin-top:2px}.spacer{flex:1}.top-actions{display:flex;gap:8px}.top-actions button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;cursor:pointer}
.top-actions button.music-on{background:rgba(142,224,200,.18);border-color:rgba(142,224,200,.58)}
.audio-dot{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#8ee0c8;margin-right:5px;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(142,224,200,.12)}
.audio-dot.off{background:#a9b0bf;box-shadow:none}
.music-note{font-size:12px;color:#657186;margin-top:10px;line-height:1.55}.progress-wrap{width:min(360px,30vw);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}.progress-track{flex:1;height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);overflow:hidden}.progress-bar{height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd47a,#8ee0c8);transition:width .25s}.progress-text{font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;opacity:.8}
.game-shell{height:calc(100vh - 68px);padding:16px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(430px,45%) minmax(520px,55%);gap:16px;max-width:1460px;width:100%;margin:0 auto;overflow:hidden}
.visual-pane{min-width:0;height:100%;background:#162139;border-radius:22px;padding:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}.image-box{flex:1;min-height:0;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}.scene-image{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block;background:#fff}.visual-info{flex:0 0 auto;color:#f2f6ff;padding:13px 5px 2px}.visual-info b{display:block;font-size:21px;margin-bottom:3px}.visual-info span{font-size:13px;opacity:.72;line-height:1.45}.skill-row{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:9px}.skill{font-size:11px;font-weight:850;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.story-pane{min-width:0;height:100%;background:#fff;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}.story-head{flex:0 0 auto;padding:17px 20px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.chapter-label{font-size:12px;font-weight:950;color:#dd7922}.chapter-name{font-size:18px;font-weight:950;margin-top:2px}.node-pill{margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;font-weight:850;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#f2f5f9;color:#59657b;white-space:nowrap}
.dialogue-scroll{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;padding:20px 22px 24px;scrollbar-width:thin}.speaker{display:inline-block;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:950;margin-bottom:10px}.story-text{font-size:20px;line-height:1.75;font-weight:720;letter-spacing:-.015em;white-space:pre-line}.thought{margin-top:13px;padding:13px 15px;border-left:5px solid #edbd57;border-radius:10px;background:#fff7df;color:#66532b;font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;font-weight:760}.scene-tag{display:inline-flex;margin-bottom:10px;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:#eef3f9;color:#536176;font-size:12px;font-weight:850}.prompt{font-size:19px;line-height:1.55;font-weight:950;margin:5px 0 13px}.choice-grid{display:grid;gap:9px}.choice{width:100%;border:1px solid #dce3ec;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;padding:13px 14px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.52;font-size:16px;transition:.13s}.choice:hover{background:#fffaf2;border-color:#efa44c}.choice:disabled{cursor:default}.choice.chosen{border:2px solid #776bd0;background:#f4f1ff}.choice.good{border:2px solid #47a58a;background:#eaf9f4}.choice.bad{border:2px solid #d57777;background:#fff0f0}
.choice-outcome{margin-top:13px;border-radius:15px;background:#f7f8fb;border:1px solid #e2e6ee;padding:15px}.you-said{font-size:13px;font-weight:900;color:#5b6680;margin-bottom:5px}.reply-bubble{font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;font-weight:760}.mind-note{margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed #d7dde7;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;color:#5b6679}.mind-note b{color:#d57922}.feedback{margin-top:12px;padding:13px 14px;border-radius:13px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;font-weight:760}.feedback.good{background:var(--goodbg);color:var(--good)}.feedback.bad{background:var(--badbg);color:var(--bad)}.reveal{margin-top:11px;padding:13px 14px;border-left:5px solid #8b76c7;border-radius:10px;background:#f5f0ff;color:#4c3e75;font-weight:820;line-height:1.6}
.stage{display:inline-flex;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:950;margin-bottom:10px}.st1{background:#fff0bd;color:#725300}.st2{background:#ead7ff;color:#603a80}.st3{background:#caf2e9;color:#176f5d}.st4{background:#cceaff;color:#245f83}.multi-hint{font-size:13px;color:#6c7689;margin:-5px 0 10px}.actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}.continue{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:19px}.lesson-card{margin-top:10px;padding:18px;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff3ce,#f2ecff);border:1px solid #ead8a4}.lesson-card b{display:block;color:#8b5a06;margin-bottom:7px}.lesson-card p{margin:0;font-size:17px;line-height:1.7;font-weight:800}.reflection{margin-top:13px;padding:14px;border-radius:13px;background:#f4f7fb;color:#536075;line-height:1.6;font-size:14px}
#result{align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:25px;overflow:auto;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#d7f5ed,#e7dcff 48%,#ffe2b4)}.result-card{width:min(850px,94vw);background:#fff;border-radius:28px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:38px;text-align:center}.result-card .icon{font-size:64px}.result-card h2{font-size:38px;margin:5px 0 9px}.result-card p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.7;color:#566176}.compass{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin:20px 0}.compass div{border-radius:13px;padding:12px 8px;font-weight:900}.compass div:nth-child(1){background:#fff0bd}.compass div:nth-child(2){background:#ead7ff}.compass div:nth-child(3){background:#caf2e9}.compass div:nth-child(4){background:#cceaff}.result-actions{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
@media(max-width:1050px){#game{height:auto;min-height:100vh;overflow:auto}.game-shell{height:auto;overflow:visible;grid-template-columns:1fr;max-width:900px}.visual-pane{height:520px}.story-pane{height:650px}.progress-wrap{display:none}}
@media(max-width:720px){#home{padding:12px}.home-card{padding:24px}.scenario-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.home-title{font-size:52px}.game-shell{padding:8px;gap:8px}.visual-pane{height:390px;padding:9px}.story-pane{height:620px}.story-text{font-size:17px}.choice{font-size:14px}.dialogue-scroll{padding:16px}.topbar{padding:0 9px}.case-mini{display:none}.top-actions button{padding:7px}.compass{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app">
<section id="home" class="screen active">
 <div class="home-card">
  <div class="brand">🧠 맞춤 SOUL FOOD · 대인관계</div>
  <h1 class="home-title">마음<span>번역소</span></h1>
  <p class="home-desc">친구의 행동을 보고 떠오른 첫 생각이 언제나 사실은 아닙니다. 긴 이야기를 따라가며 중간중간 <b>내가 직접 대화를 선택</b>하고, 마지막에는 <b>보이는 사실 → 예상되는 마음 → 확인 질문 → 관계를 살리는 말</b>로 마음을 다시 번역해 보세요.</p>
  <div class="promise"><span>👀 사실과 추측 구분</span><span>💭 여러 관점 열기</span><span>❓ 질문으로 확인</span><span>❤️ 관계 회복하기</span></div>
  <div class="mode-row"><button class="btn primary" id="randomBtn">🎲 사건 하나 시작</button><button class="btn soft" id="allBtn">📚 6개 이야기 연속 도전</button></div><div class="music-note">🎵 게임을 시작하면 저작권 음원 파일을 사용하지 않는 <b>브라우저 생성형 배경음</b>이 잔잔하게 재생됩니다. 상단 버튼에서 언제든 끌 수 있어요.</div>
  <div class="scenario-grid" id="scenarioGrid"></div>
 </div>
</section>

<section id="game" class="screen">
 <div class="topbar">
  <div><div class="brand-mini">마음번역소</div><div class="case-mini" id="topCase"></div></div>
  <div class="spacer"></div>
  <div class="progress-wrap"><div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-bar" id="progressBar"></div></div><div class="progress-text" id="progressText"></div></div>
  <div class="top-actions"><button id="musicBtn" class="music-on"><span class="audio-dot" id="audioDot"></span><span id="musicLabel">음악 ON</span></button><button id="volBtn" title="배경음 크기 조절">🔉</button><button id="homeBtn">처음으로</button><button id="fullBtn">전체화면</button></div>
 </div>
 <main class="game-shell">
  <aside class="visual-pane">
   <div class="image-box"><img id="sceneImage" class="scene-image" alt="상황 장면"></div>
   <div class="visual-info"><b id="visualTitle"></b><span id="visualSubtitle"></span><div class="skill-row"><span class="skill">관계인식</span><span class="skill">관계관리</span><span class="skill">공감</span><span class="skill">감정표현</span></div></div>
  </aside>
  <section class="story-pane">
   <div class="story-head"><div><div class="chapter-label" id="chapterLabel"></div><div class="chapter-name" id="chapterName"></div></div><div class="node-pill" id="nodePill"></div></div>
   <div class="dialogue-scroll" id="dialogueScroll"></div>
  </section>
 </main>
</section>

<section id="result" class="screen">
 <div class="result-card">
  <div class="icon">🌱</div><h2 id="resultTitle">마음번역 완료</h2><p id="resultText"></p>
  <div class="compass"><div>👀 사실 보기</div><div>💭 관점 열기</div><div>❓ 질문하기</div><div>❤️ 관계 살리기</div></div>
  <div class="result-actions"><button class="btn primary" id="nextCaseBtn">다른 이야기</button><button class="btn soft" id="retryBtn">다시 해 보기</button><button class="btn ghost" id="resultHomeBtn">처음으로</button></div>
 </div>
</section>
</div>
<script>
const SCENARIOS = [{"id":"greeting","number":"사건 1","title":"대답 없는 인사","subtitle":"보이지 않는 아침","image":"data:image/webp;base64,
